head: working-tree
subject: CDS HTTP/2 upstream protocol limits
change: Cluster.upstream_config (field 48) now accepts the Envoy HttpProtocolOptions extension when it selects http2_protocol_options. The decoder maps hpack_table_size, max_concurrent_streams, initial_stream_window_size and initial_connection_window_size into a per-cluster override. The runtime controller applies the override on top of the application's target HTTP/2 limits when projecting an EDS cluster. HTTP/1, HTTP/3 and automatic/downstream protocol selection fail closed.

unit: src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig 'gRPC CDS decodes HTTP/2 upstream protocol limits' decodes all four mapped wrappers.
src/grpc/xds/runtime/target_tests.zig 'gRPC xDS controller projects CDS HTTP/2 upstream limits' projects an EDS assignment and asserts the endpoint connection limits.

target.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC xDS target' --summary all

notes: Per-cluster HTTP/2 limits now flow from CDS through the EDS projection. transport_socket_matches, lrs_server, SDS/certificate providers and non-router filters remain open.
